M0-T2.title: Spike 2 (seams): join all 6 module types in a stress spec with offsets; measure seam gaps + socket misalignment; fix [auto] tolerances from real numbers
tests_added: src/spikes/seams/seamStress.test.ts — 13 tests: exactness (78 socket-solved joins @ zero offset all ≤ float eps); kit scanner flags engineering.high-hatch@1.2m; spine-face flush mating per room type; normal/lateral/vertical offset response slope 1.000 under both policies; noise ≤ 2ε bounds (door vertical + far-face shift); ±0.5 mm margin claims (≥2× watertight, ≥5× hatch); ±1.0 mm = zero-headroom ceiling; pathological reject set (10/25 mm offsets + 200 mm authored high-hatch step); tolerance constants exported
M0-T2.verification: lint 0w/0e (14 files); typecheck clean; test 18/18 passed (3 files); build green; prettier clean on new files
M0-T2.notes: VERDICT: proven. White-box stand-ins for all 6 module types joined socket-to-socket: 78 joins @ zero offset → max seam gap/lateral/vertical/floorStep = 0.000000 mm (join math is never the error source). Offset response linear & axis-separated (normal δ → open seam δ; lateral δ → misalign δ; vertical δ swallowed by floor pin / becomes door-miss+floor-step under door solve). Authoring noise ±0.5 mm → ≤1.0 mm bounds (2× margin vs 2 mm watertight cap, 5× vs 5 mm hatch cap; ±1.0 mm = zero headroom → 0.5 mm is the authoring ceiling). Pathological joins (≥10 mm offsets; engineering 1.2 m high-hatch vs standard 1.0 m door → 200 mm step) exceed both caps → validator reject set. Decision: sockets are the ONLY join interface (M3-T2 'never freehand' now measured, not asserted); floor-pinned assembly (walkable deck plates) with XZ from sockets; tolerances fixed in src/spikes/seams/tolerances.ts (imported by M0-T6/M1-T3): watertightGapMm 2, hatchAlignMm 5, maxSocketAuthoringErrorMm 0.5, standardDoorCenterM 1.0. Full verdict + measured report card in docs/spikes.md.
